## Setting Plots theme

```{julia}
my_theme = Theme(
    Axis=(
        yminorticks=IntervalsBetween(2),
        yminorgridvisible=true,
        xminorticks=IntervalsBetween(2),
        xminorgridvisible=true,
        xlabelfont=:bold,
        ylabelfont=:bold,
        leftspinecolor=:gray60,
        rightspinecolor=:gray60,
        topspinecolor=:gray60,
        bottomspinecolor=:gray60,
    )
)

my_log_theme = Theme(
    Axis=(
        yminorgridvisible=true,
        xminorticks=IntervalsBetween(2),
        xminorgridvisible=true,
        xlabelfont=:bold,
        ylabelfont=:bold,
        leftspinecolor=:gray60,
        rightspinecolor=:gray60,
        topspinecolor=:gray60,
        bottomspinecolor=:gray60,
        yscale=log10,
        yminorticks=IntervalsBetween(10),
        ytickformat=x -> string.(round.(x, digits=1)),
    )
)

set_theme!(my_theme)
```

## Tabular Summary of Subject Characteristics


```{julia}
adata_subj = unique(prot002, :USUBJID) # Subset to one row per subject (USUBJID)
table_one_mod( # bespoke function table_one_mod - renders Total column in the last. Use table_one to get it in the front.
    adata_subj,
    [
        :SEX => "Sex",
        :AGE => "Age [yr]",
        :WTBL => "Baseline Weight [kg]",
        :BMIBL => "Baseline BMI [kg/m²]",
        :EGFRBL => "Baseline eGFR (CKD-2021) [mL/min/1.73 m²]"
    ],
    groupby=:STUDYID => "Study",
    show_n=true,
    footnotes=[
        "Abbreviations: BMI = body mass index, CKD = chronic kidney disease, 
        eGFR = estimated glomerular filtration rate, max = maximum, min = minimum, SD = Standard Deviation",
        "Note: Missing row appears only when there are missing values"
        ]
)
```

## Correlation between covariates

```{julia}
pair_plot = @chain prot002 begin
    @select :STUDYIDN :USUBJID :AGE :BMIBL :EGFRBL :WTBL # select only covariate data & unique identifiers
    unique # filter to keep only unique
    @select :AGE :BMIBL :EGFRBL :WTBL
    @rename begin # Renaming the columns
        $("Age [yr]") = :AGE
        $(:"BMI [kg/m²]") = :BMIBL
        $(:"eGFR [mL/min/m²]") = :EGFRBL
        $(:"Weight [kg]") = :WTBL
    end
    dropmissing

    # The following function is defined in 20-poppk/julia-functions/pairplot-with-regression.
    # Regression Line with CI Band is not available in PairPlots.jl
    pairplot_with_regression(
        color=:royalblue3,
        title="Correlation between Continuous-Valued Covariates",
        subtitle="CDISCPILOT01",
        size=(800, 800)
    )
end
```

##  Visualize Covariate Distributions

### Continuous variates

```{julia}
dist_layer = @chain prot002 begin
    @select :STUDYID :USUBJID :AGE :BMIBL :EGFRBL :WTBL # select only continuous covariate data & unique identifiers
    unique # filter to keep only unique
    @rename begin # Renaming the columns
        $("Age [yr]") = :AGE
        $(:"BMI [kg/m²]") = :BMIBL
        $(:"eGFR [mL/min/m²]") = :EGFRBL
        $(:"Weight [kg]") = :WTBL
    end
    stack(_, [:"Age [yr]", :"BMI [kg/m²]", :"eGFR [mL/min/m²]", :"Weight [kg]"])
    # dropmissing

    data(_) *
    mapping(
        :value,
        layout=:variable,
        color=:variable,
    )

end
```

## Categirocal variates

```{julia}
cat_cov = @chain prot002 begin
    @select :USUBJID :SEX # Select Categorical covariates
    unique # Getting unique subjects - onw row per subject
    @groupby :SEX
    @combine :n = length(:USUBJID)
    dropmissing


    data(_) *
    mapping(
        :SEX,
        :n,
        color=:SEX
    ) *
    visual(BarPlot,
        color=:lightblue
    )
end

draw(cat_cov,
    figure=(;
        title="Barplots of Categorical Covariates",
        subtitle="CDISCPILOT01"
    ),
    axis=(;
        title="Sex",
        yticks=0:10:50,
        ylabel="Number of Subjects",
        xlabel=""
    ),
    scales(;
        Color=(;
            palette=[:pink, :lightblue]
        )
    ),
    legend=(;
        show=false
    )
)
```

## Tabular Summary of BLOQ by Nominal Time relative to previous dose

```{julia}
blq_smr = @chain prot002 begin
    @transform(:NFRLTC = @. string(round(:NFRLT, digits = 2)))
    @rsubset :EVID == 0
    @groupby :NFRLTC
    @combine begin
        :N = length(:DV)
        :NBLQ = sum(:BLQFN)
        :"BLQ [%]" = round(sum(:BLQFN) / length(:DV) * 100, digits = 1)
    end
end

total_n = sum(blq_smr.N)
total_nblq = sum(blq_smr.NBLQ)
total_pc_nblq = round(sum(blq_smr.NBLQ) / total_n * 100, digits=1)

# Formatting the TOTAL row to bold and making a DataFrame
blq_tot_smr = DataFrame([
    :NFRLTC => [styled"{bold:Total}"],
    :N => [styled"{bold:$total_n}"],
    :NBLQ => [styled"{bold:$total_nblq}"],
    Symbol("BLQ [%]") => [styled"{bold:$total_pc_nblq}"]
])

@chain vcat(blq_smr, blq_tot_smr) begin
    @rtransform begin
        :NBLQ = :NBLQ == 0 ? "-" : :NBLQ
        :"BLQ [%]" = :"BLQ [%]" == 0 ? "-" : :"BLQ [%]"
    end

    simple_table(
        [
            :NFRLTC => Annotated("Nominal Sampling Time [hr]", "Relative to previous dose", label="a"),
            :N => Annotated("N", "Number of Samples", label="b"),
            :NBLQ => Annotated("NBLQ", "Number of BLQ samples", label="c"),
            Symbol("BLQ [%]")
        ],
        halign=[:left, :right, :right, :right]
    )
end
```

## Derive Plotting Data

```{julia}
pdata = @chain prot002 begin
    @rsubset :STUDYID == "PROTOCOL-002"

    @transform :TXA = categorical(
        ismissing(:FREQC) ? missing :
        replace(:FREQC, r" \(BID\)" => "BID")
    )

  @rtransform :DVNUM =
    ismissing(:DV) ? missing : tryparse(Float64, :DV)

    @rtransform :DNDV =
        (ismissing(:DVNUM) || ismissing(:DOSEA) || :DOSEA == 0) ?
        missing :
        :DVNUM / :DOSEA

    @select :USUBJID :NFRLT :AFRLT :EVID :AMT :DV :DVNUM :DNDV :BLQFL :FREQC :TXA :DOSEA
end
```



```{julia}
safe_median(x) = begin
    v = collect(skipmissing(x))
    v = filter(!isnothing, v)
    isempty(v) ? missing : median(v)
end

pdata_smr = @chain pdata begin
    @rsubset :EVID == 0
    @groupby :TXA :NFRLT
    @combine(
        :DVP50   = safe_median(:DVNUM),
        :DNDVP50 = safe_median(:DNDV),
    )
end
```

## Defining plot layers

```{julia}
individual_lines =
    data(pdata) *
    mapping(
        :AFRLT,
        :DV,
        group=:USUBJID
    ) *
    visual(
        Lines,
        alpha = 0.5,
        color=:gray75
    )


lloq_line =
    mapping(0) *  # LLOQ = 5
    visual(
        HLines,
        linestyle=:dash,
        color=:red,
        linewidth=1,
        label="LLOQ (0 ng/mL)"
    )

rug_nfrlt =
    mapping(unique(pdata_smr.NFRLT)) *
    visual(VLines; color=:red, ymin=0, ymax=0.05, linewidth=1)

median_layer =
    data(pdata_smr) *
    mapping(
        :NFRLT,
        :DVP50
    ) *
    visual(Lines)

dn_median_layer =
    data(pdata_smr) *
    mapping(
        :NFRLT,
        :DNDVP50
    ) *
    visual(Lines)

median_grouping =
    mapping(
        color=:TXA => sorter(unique(pdata_smr.TXA)),
        linestyle=:TXA => sorter(unique(pdata_smr.TXA))
    )

layout_by_TXA =
    mapping(layout=:TXA => sorter(unique(pdata_smr.TXA)))
```

## Median C-T Profiles

```{julia}
with_theme(my_log_theme) do
    median_ct_plot =
        (
            median_layer * median_grouping
            +
            lloq_line
            +
            rug_nfrlt
        ) |>
        draw(
            figure=(
                title="Median Observed Concentration vs Time, by Dose Level",
                subtitle="CDISCPILOT01",
                size=(800, 600)
            ),
            axis=(ylabel="Plasma Concentration [ng/mL]",
                limits=(nothing, nothing, nothing, nothing)
            ),
            legend=(
                position=:bottom,
                nbanks=2,
                framevisible=false,
                titlesize=0
            )
        )
end
```
